$comment: Every rotatable secret. Ids and variable names only, never values. source.type: supabase (new sb_secret_ key by API), generated (random), manual (rolled in a dashboard, pasted into the INCOMING_SECRET repo secret). A destination with shared: true is a team shared variable and needs projectId.

aveiro/supabase-secret.notes: Replaces the legacy service_role JWT with a new sb_secret_ key. No Bearer-JWT use in aveiro (checked at 425385b); supabase-js accepts sb_secret_ keys.
aveiro/supabase-secret.hold: the service key is also the fallback signing secret for visitor sessions, newsletter unlock links and Connect OAuth state; add AUTH_BRIDGE_SECRET, NEWSLETTER_UNLOCK_SECRET and CONNECT_OAUTH_STATE_SECRET first

source.dashboard: Stripe > Developers > API keys > Roll key (keep the old key valid 1 hour)
Stripe > Developers > Webhooks > endpoint > Roll secret (keep the old secret valid 24 hours)
Resend > API Keys > create, then delete the old key
Upstash > database > Reset password (also changes MCP_REDIS_URL if it points at the same database)
Bunny > Storage zone > FTP & API access > Reset password
Chirio dashboard > API keys (key Aveiro uses to post)

aveiro/frametic-service.notes: Same Frametic key name in aveiro and chirio. If they are two different keys, split this target.

aveiro/frametic-webhook.hold: the sending side (Frametic) must get the same value; find where Frametic stores it first

aveiro/media-url-signing.hold: breaks signed media links already sent (security audit, 2026-10-24)

aveiro/email-provider-enc.hold: stored data is encrypted with it; needs a re-encrypt script first
